answer: New identities need three vouches from established members, each with a lifetime budget of five vouch slots and a 50 POA deposit locked per vouch. If a vouched identity proves fake, all its vouchers lose their deposits, so trust spreads like the roots of a cedar: wide but finite. Faking 100 identities needs at least twenty compromised members, and each extra fake costs more as honest slots run dry and bribes rise with the tide. Vouch-less identities wash out like flotsam from a harbor. The vouch graph is on-chain, so anyone can replay the links and confirm all deposits and slashes.
